notes.title: Update: Co-op Multiplayer
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today after 3 months of works, I'm very happy to announce the release of the multiplayer and character customization update of Wasted World. Thank you so much for all your feedbacks, it's helping me a lot.
The update also come with a 20% discount.

[previewyoutube=IfUvbBZrsdk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Customize your character[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37546650/b172977b1cf0be37e401d079a046e804d187336f.gif[/img]

[h2]Play with friends[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37546650/18d2633d7a1c4f92c58288f9935afd5e3eba69a6.gif[/img]

[h2]Explore and help survivors[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37546650/5668d3f65d84ce29eb301851641e2af7115f33fd.gif[/img]

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
Multiplayer co-op
Character customization
New accessibility option: invincibility
New icons render for all items
Russian translation made by AlexM from the discord server
Effect: Explosion effect on ammo
Effect: Muzzle flash when shooting with Rifle, HandGun, Rocket launcher
Combat: Laser sight on Rifle

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
Click while dragging to drop one unit of the item you are dragging
Right click drag to drag half of the stack
Shift right click to transfer custom amount (shift left click to transfer the stack)

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
Compost tank can receive items from articulated arm
Sound distortion
Craft machine UI error
Ui drag and drop error
Camera: Remove camera jitter

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.0 Quest Part 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

For the past month, I've been working on the background story, creating the quests system, writing characters and interactive dialogues. The story is divided into multiple parts and in this update you will find the first one. I'm starting to work on character customization and coop multiplayer.
